source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Note the items not in compliance in as much detail as possible.
3. Document what hazard(s) these non-compliance items create.
4. Document a plan to correct those non-compliance items.
5. Include a timeline for completion of the correction plan.
6. Include a responsible party to carry out the correction plan.
7. Include documentation of what training is needed to sustain the correction.
8. Include documentation of how the fix will be verified.
